name: get_vercel_ci_task_logs
description:
Returns log lines for the tasks of an invocation attempt in a single request, grouped by task. Tasks can be narrowed by name and by conclusion, for example `conclusion=failed` to fetch only the logs of failed tasks.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/vercel-ci/invocations/{invocationId}/attempts/{attempt}/task-logs --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

conclusion.description: Only return completed tasks with one of these conclusions.

level.description: Only return log lines with one of these levels.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default: 10, max: 25).

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

task.description: Only return tasks with one of these names (e.g., \"web#test\").

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
